item.content:encoded: Interesting and lighthearted! I stumbled upon this article by accident, and it was a good, quick read. Not very much substance, but these small stories are some of the stuff that makes this site great. I actually expected the whole thing to be a sham the UIU got caught on, so it even gave me a little twist to experience. And as a final note, always surrender yourself! Nobody posts only masterpieces. Even if an idea doesn’t seem to be going anywhere, there are still lots of people around who will probably enjoy what you can come up with!

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
So, this was originally devised in October when I was like "ahh yes, I should write a SCP for halloween". It very quickly became a UIU format and then, stagnated for a long time.

Honestly, posting this is an act of surrender: I've spent a lot of time considering how I can pull this off better with less sympathetic FBI agents but I never really managed to pull it off. ACAB

Big thanks to: RealAmerican, who helped shape an early version of this; and to DarkStuff who helped with a nearly done version. And then I uh, changed the second interview a lot and posted about 40% of this relatively cold oops.

Image sources:

  • UIU_Logo.png is from http://www.scp-wiki.net/component:uiu-bhl-theme
  • house_of_interest.jpg: Basher Eyre / "Spooky" house in London Road / CC BY-SA 2.0
[+] Spoilers
[-] Spoilers
  • So this is entirely built around a pun: specifically, Mrs Haughton has trophy husbands (hot young men she's married to) that she turns into hunting trophys.
  • The broken-masqeurade tag is because this very quietly only works in a broken masquerade canon and I count it as being part of the canon as a result; though the framing means it barely touches on the whole masquerade breaking part.
